title: 宝塚記念の後に・リベンジ達成！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa defeats Silence Suzuka. This time, she keeps her feet firmly planted after her victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While congratulating her, Silence Suzuka tells El Condor Pasa that she has the ability to turn the cheers of her fans into strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This puzzles El Condor Pasa, since she believes all runners have the same ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She ruminates on Silence Suzuka's words and heads toward the Japan Cup.
